detail.longDescription: 🐧 Linux Kernel 7.2 Officially Released, This Is What’s New - 9to5Linux ｢ Linux kernel 7.2 also introduces a “Fair(er)” GPU scheduler, support for the ‘zerocopy’ library to Rust support to make zero-cost memory manipulation effortless, new hwcaps for the 2025 dpISA extensions on the AArch64 (ARM64) architecture, and enables large folios by default for the Btrfs file system ｣ https:// 9to5linux.com/linux-kernel-7-2 -officially-released-this-is-whats-new # linux # kernel # opensource
